Notification NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) dt.16.11.2026 (CTSE 2026 Re-exam) 
 Published on : 16-11-2026 04:00 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04(VOL-1) Dated, Kohima the 16 th November, 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In continuation to the Commission’s Notification of even number dated 28th October, 2026 in the matter of re-examination for the candidates of Mechanical Engineering (Diploma) those candidates who have appeared in GE & GK Paper on 26th September, 2026 and any of the descriptive Paper I & II and MCQ paper on 6th and 7th October 2026 shall be allowed to sit for re-examination on 21st November, 2026. 
2. Those candidates who appeared only GE & GK Paper shall not be allowed to sit for re-examination. 
3. Those candidates who appeared only Paper I & II and MCQ or any one of the electives and absent in GE & GK Paper shall not be allowed to sit for re-examination.
